title: H08 — Significant Difference: Main Road (t-test)
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing price data. Is there a significant difference in house prices between houses on the main road and houses not on the main road? Use an independent samples t-test. Consider the difference significant if the p-value is less than 0.05. Report your answer in this exact format: @significant_difference[value] @p_value[value] where significant_difference is yes or no and p_value is rounded to four decimal places.
